repro: grep -A2 -F "extract_frontmatter() {" scripts/validate.sh | grep -q awk && ! grep -qF ",/^---" scripts/validate.sh
summary: validate.sh read frontmatter with a sed '/^---$/,/^---$/p' range that over-captured whenever a body line was '---', and piping it into grep -q raised SIGPIPE under set -o pipefail; ~6% of runs emitted false warnings/errors. Fixed by the extract_frontmatter() awk helper plus here-strings (d897d44).
